questions.stem: Which of the following is the principal metabolite in norepinephrine metabolism excreted in urine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vanillylmandelic acid

Levels of VMA are important in the diagnosis of adrenal pathologies.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 139.

questions.stem: A patient suffering from pheochromocytoma complains of thirst, dry mouth, and hunger. A blood test for sugar revealed hyperglycemia. What type of hyperglycemia is this?
questions.solutionHtml:
Adrenal

Pheochromocytoma is a tumor of the adrenal medulla that secretes excessive amounts of epinephrine and norepinephrine. So, in the case of pheochromocytoma, there is adrenal hyperglycemia.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 150.

questions.stem: Mineralocorticoids play a critical role in fluid and electrolyte balance in the body. A normal response to aldosterone is to increase acid secretion in the kidney. The hyperaldosteronism that occurs with some adrenal tumors have interesting and profound effects on acid-base balance as a result of increased renal H+ secretion. Which of the following would be the most likely result of hyperaldosteronism?

options.label: C
options.text: Hyperkalemia caused by renal K+ resorption

options.label: D
options.text: Increased H+ reabsorption by renal tubular cell

questions.solutionHtml:
Generation Of Metabolic Alkalosis

Hyperaldosteronism leads to a loss of potassium and hypokalemia. Hypokalemia leads to a loss of potassium from cells largely in exchange for H+. This causes metabolic alkalosis and intracellular acidosis.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 150, Goodman HM.Adrenal glands. In: Johnson LR, ed. Essential Medical Physiology. 3rd Edition. San 607-635.

questions.stem: Adrenalectomized animals are unable to survive even brief periods of food deprivation. Cortisol replacement restores the ability to survive fast. Which of the following is the best explanation for this observation?

options.label: A
options.text: Cortisol can act synergistically with insulin

options.label: B
options.text: Cortisol can act antagonistically to the action of growth hormone

options.label: C
options.text: Cortisol has a permissive effect on enzymes involved in the mobilization of various fuels

options.label: D
options.text: Cortisol increases glucose utilization and decreases glycogen storage

questions.answerText: Cortisol has a permissive effect on enzymes involved in the mobilization of various fuels
questions.solutionHtml:
Cortisol has a permissive effect on enzymes involved in the mobilization of various fuels

Cortisol increases proteolysis and induces the transaminases necessary to convert pyruvate into alanine for transport to the liver for gluconeogenesis.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 150, Goodman HM.Adrenal glands. In: Johnson LR, ed. Essential Medical Physiology. 3rd Edition. San 607-635.
